titulo.alumno: A rhetorical contrast · Digital media and rhetoric

intro: Part 3: a rhetorical contrast. Compare the two clues and distinguish what the text says from what it only seems to suggest.

texto: A headline selects one aspect and can intensify it. Look for omissions, comparisons and evaluative words; distinguish a quotation from the editorial voice, and check whether the link supports the summary.
